info.description: Speedclub member API. Errors: {message, code, errors}. Locale: Accept-Language (de default).

post.description:
Needs the `password` and, with two-factor on, `code` (authenticator or recovery code); wrong or missing: 422 on the field. Closes
the account at once: profile and vehicles disappear everywhere, QR stickers stop working, every device is signed out, follows
end. Messages stay for the other side as "Gelöschtes Mitglied". Everything is deleted for good within 30 days; there is no way back,
and signing in answers as for an unknown account. Open under every restriction. The same deletion as /konto-loeschen (WEB-05).

post.description:
Needs the current `password` (422 on `password` when wrong) and, with two-factor on, a current `code` (TOTP or recovery code;
missing: 422 `two_factor_code_required`, wrong: 422 on `code`). The same 202 whether or not the new address has an account: a free
address gets a six-digit code, valid 10 minutes; a taken one gets nothing, and its owner is told someone tried. Nothing is sent
during the cooldown of `resend_after_seconds` or above the code budget (5 an hour, 10 a day). 422 on `email` for the current
address.

post.description:
The code from the mail to the new address. Switches the account to it (still verified) and mails the previous address. A wrong,
used or expired code: 422 `invalid_code`; nothing pending: 422 `invalid_code` with the reason. An address that has an account by
now, or had one when the code was asked for: 422 on `email`, "Diese Adresse kann nicht verwendet werden.", and the change ends.

post.description:
`current_password` wrong: 422 on it. With two-factor on, a current `code` too (TOTP or recovery code; missing: 422
`two_factor_code_required`, wrong: 422 on `code`). The new `password` follows the policy of 02_PRODUCT_SPEC §3.1 (each broken rule its own
message) and must differ from the current one and the username. This device stays signed in. Other browsers are signed out by any
password change; with `revoke_other_sessions: true` the app on every other device too (its push tokens go with it). A security
mail and an in-app notice follow.

Always 202 `{attempt_id, resend_after}`, with the same body and duration whether or not the address has an account. `attempt_id` is
made by the app (a UUID) and kept on the device; send it again with the code to POST auth/email/verify. The mail holds the 6-digit
code (10 minutes, single use) and an "Anmelden" button that works only on this device. Nothing is sent during the cooldown
(`resend_after`: 30 s, 60 s, then 120 s), above 5 codes an hour for the address, or while it is locked after 10 wrong codes.
While `auth.email_code` is switched off (ADR-520: a host that cannot deliver mail yet): 404 `feature_disabled`, nothing is sent.

post.description:
**With `attempt_id` (AUTH-13, passwordless):** the `code` or the `magic_token` of the mail's link signs in; an address without an
account gets one (`is_new: true`, `next: terms` until POST me/onboarding/accept). Wrong code: 422 `invalid_code` with
`attempts_left`; expired: 422 `code_expired`; 10 wrong codes in an hour: 429 `email_code_locked` with `retry_after` (15 minutes,
and a security mail to the account). With two-factor on the answer is the challenge, as at sign-in.

**Without `attempt_id` (registration with a password):**
Needs the code and `password`, the password chosen at registration. A request already signed in as this account
(an unverified member may sign in) leaves `password` out. With `device_name` the answer holds a token for that
device, and `device_id` (the app's per-install id) tells two devices of the same model apart, as at sign-in.
Without `device_name` the SPA session is signed in, which needs GET /sanctum/csrf-cookie first (419 otherwise). A wrong,
unknown, used or expired code and a password that does not match all answer 422 `invalid_code`; someone whose
password does not match uses forgot password. Success ends every earlier token and session of the account. A member
who must change the password is verified but not signed in: 403 `password_change_required`, and a reset code is on
its way. An account with two-factor answers `{two_factor_required: true, challenge, expires_in}` as at sign-in.

While `auth.email_code` is switched off (ADR-520: a host that cannot deliver mail yet) the passwordless form answers 404
`feature_disabled`, as POST auth/email/start does; the registration form is not affected.

`invite_code` (M5.9d, optional, both forms): the code of a /join/{code} link, redeemed when the account activates (verified address and
accepted terms); ignored for an account that is active already and for an unknown, used or malformed code, never refused.

post.description:
With `device_name` the answer holds a token for that device, replacing its old one. `device_id`, the app's per-install id
(8 to 64 letters, digits and dashes, e.g. a UUID), tells two devices of the same model apart: with it, only the token of that
install is replaced; without it, the token with the same `device_name` and `platform`. Without `device_name` the SPA session is
signed in, which needs GET /sanctum/csrf-cookie first (419 otherwise). Wrong password or unknown address: 401
`invalid_credentials`. Repeated failures: 429 with Retry-After. Suspended: 403 `account_restricted`. New password
needed: 403 `password_change_required`, and a reset code is on its way. An unverified member does get in;
`next_step` says where to resume. An account with two-factor gets `{two_factor_required: true, challenge, expires_in}` instead
of a session or token: send the challenge with a code to POST auth/two-factor/challenge (AUTH-11). A closed account (deletion
requested) answers 401 `invalid_credentials` like a wrong password.

cookie session. The old token keeps working for two more minutes, so a lost answer does not end the session: sent again
with the old token, this revokes the unused new token and answers a fresh one. Once the new token has been used, the old
token answers 409 `conflict` here and stops working at once. After the two minutes it answers 401 like any expired token.
Send `device_id` as at sign-in: a token from before the app sent one takes it here, so its successor is that install's alone.

get.description:
PNG, 1080 × 1920 (`format=story`, default) or 1080 × 1080 (`square`): the cover photo, make and model, three specs, @username when
the owner shows themselves, the Build Score and the Dex number when the build has them, the QR code of the build's page (ADR-514)
with the logo beside it. The square card keeps the photo in its upper part and holds everything else in a band below it (CF-6).
CF-6 customisation: `photo`, `show` and `theme`; R5-2e (VEH-07 2.0): `template` (`band`, `poster`, `frame`), the crop (`zoom`, `x`,
`y`, in the template's photo box aspect), the `mods` element and an own `text` line (see the parameters). Without parameters (or with
the defaults) the card is the stored one at `share_card_url`; any other choice is drawn for this viewer, cached privately and never
given a URL. 422 on `text` for characters the card fonts do not draw, more than 60 characters or a blocked term (`content_blocked`).
`{id}` is the vehicle id. 404 `vehicle_unavailable` for a vehicle the viewer may not see, or one without a usable photo; 422 on
`photo` for an id that is not one of the build's public photos. The stored card of a public build is also at `share_card_url`,
which can be cached forever; this answer is `private`.

parameters.name: format
parameters.description: `story` 1080 × 1920 (default) or `square` 1080 × 1080.

parameters.name: template
parameters.description:
R5-2e: the layout. `band` (default) = the card as before (square: photo on top, band below; story: photo edge to edge, data
at the bottom); `poster` = the photo edge to edge on both formats under a dark scrim, the name large at the top of the safe
area, data and QR at the bottom, always dark; `frame` = the photo inset on a solid ground with a caption block, takes `theme`.

parameters.name: photo
parameters.description:
CF-6: the media id of one of the build's photos that everybody may see (ready, not rejected); default the cover. Any other
id answers 422 on `photo`, without saying whether it exists.

parameters.name: zoom
parameters.description:
R5-2e crop: 1.00 (default) to 3.00, at most two decimals. 1 = the largest window of the template's photo box aspect that
fits the photo (photo boxes: band 1080 × 600 square / 1080 × 1920 story, poster 1080 × 1080 / 1080 × 1920, frame
984 × 600 / 984 × 1080).

parameters.name: x
parameters.description:
R5-2e crop: the horizontal centre of the window in the photo, 0 to 1; default the photo's focal point, else 0.5. The server
clamps the window inside the photo (never letterboxes).

parameters.name: y
parameters.description: R5-2e crop: the vertical centre of the window in the photo, 0 to 1; default the focal point, else 0.5. Clamped as `x`.

parameters.name: show[]
parameters.description:
CF-6 / R5-2e: what the card shows besides the photo, the make and the model, a subset of `score`, `dex`, `specs`, `mods`,
`username`, `qr` (default: `score,dex,specs,username,qr`, what the build has). Bracketed (`show[]=score&show[]=qr`) or
comma-separated (`show=score,qr`); an empty `show=` shows none. `mods` (off by default) = "12 Mods" and up to two of the
build's installed mods that fit on the line. Without `qr` the card carries no code. `username` still needs the owner to
show themselves (ADR-148 a).

parameters.name: theme
parameters.description: CF-6 / R5-2e: `dark` (default) or `light`, for the square `band` and both `frame` formats; ignored elsewhere.

parameters.name: text
parameters.description:
R5-2e: the member's own line, at most 60 characters after trim, one line. Letters, digits, spaces and common punctuation
(Latin, Latin-1, Latin Extended-A, `–—„“”‚‘’…·•`); anything else (emoji, control characters, line breaks) answers 422 on
`text`. A term of the keyword block list answers 422 `content_blocked` on `text`.

M4.15 (ADR-452): the VAPID public key (base64url) the member web subscribes with; null while the server has no VAPID keys,
and then the browser option stays hidden. The flag `web_push` switches the option and the delivery on top.

errors.description: Messages by field; empty when the error is not about one field.
Messages by field; empty when the error is not about one field.

AppealStatus.description: An internal complaint (Art. 20 DSA): open until a staff member other than the decider rules on it (Phase 3, ADM-24). Upheld keeps the decision, reversed undoes it.
AppealStatus.title: AppealStatus

AppleSignInRequest.description:
POST auth/apple (09 §8.1). raw_nonce comes from POST auth/nonce; the app hashed it (SHA-256) for Apple. full_name arrives from Apple on the first
authorisation only and is stored at once; the address is always taken from the verified token, never from the body.

email.description: Ignored: Apple's address is read from the verified token. Accepted so the client may send what the SDK returned.

device_id.description: The app's per-install id (a UUID kept in secure storage). Tells two devices of the same model apart; ignored without device_name.

os_version.description: M4.7 (09 §8.4): the system version, for SET-06 ("Android 16").

AttemptRequest.description: POST me/reauth/email: the attempt id the app made for this code (as at sign-in).

AuthNextStep.title: AuthNextStep

BadgeCategory.description: M5.9d badges (m5.9d contract §2): the groups of the badge row and the admin badge manager.
BadgeCategory.title: BadgeCategory

hidden.description: A hidden badge not earned yet: show "???" and the hint.

hint.description: The hint of a hidden badge (also once earned); null for the others.

earned_at.description: When the member earned it; null when not (yet).

BadgeTier.description: M5.9d badges (m5.9d contract §2, §10.2): the three tiers the app draws.
BadgeTier.title: BadgeTier

username.description: The name as the member blocked it, lowercased. Unblock with this name.

blocked_at.description: When the member blocked them, ISO 8601.

about.description: One or two sentences from the catalogue, in the reader's language; null when the catalogue has none.

category.description: The mod category key the brand is best known for. @var string|null

builds.description: Visible real builds with a mod of this brand ("1.204 Builds"); samples never count (DQ-1140), 0 = hide the number.

lines.description: Product lines with their number of active products, by name.

anyOf.description:
ADR-457: the lead photo, a build carrying the brand's most-used product (a real build; a sample only while samples are shown,
badged by `vehicle.is_sample`); null when no build with a photo carries one.

build_photos.description: ADR-457 "Beliebt in Builds": up to 8 builds with a mod of the brand, real builds before samples.

builds.description: Visible real builds with a mod of this brand; samples never count (DQ-1140), 0 = hide the number.

quote.description: The owner's own words from the description, never invented; null without a description.

vehicle.description: The build behind the photo; `path` opens VEH-01 ("/v/{slug}").

product.description: The catalogue product this build carries (BRD-02), or null.

stages.description: Stage 1–5 and the score each starts at.

parts.description:
completeness, documentation, community, journey. Each item gives `points` per unit for at most `limit` units (null: once),
capped at `max`; `description` needs `min_chars` characters.

Owner only: the four parts with their caps. A visitor never gets them (the community part is mostly 2 points per
reacting member, and reaction counts are private).

ranks.description:
Generation first ("#4 von 61 EK9 in Deutschland"), then the owner's Bundesland ("#2 in NRW"); only groups of at least 3
public cars, computed nightly. Empty for a private, ghost or sample car.

previous_total.description:
Owner only: the total before the last change, for "+25"; null before the first change. A visitor never gets it (one
step of 2 or 1 points is a single new reaction, spotter or follower).

next_upgrades.description:
Owner only, most points first: what can still be added. Keys photos, key_specs, description, cover_focal, documented_mods,
planned_mods, registered_mods, timeline, before_after; progress need − have is what is missing (description: characters).

BuildUpdateAudience.description: Who sees a build update (09 §8.5): everybody who may see the vehicle, or only its followers (members following the owner or the vehicle) and the owner.
BuildUpdateAudience.title: BuildUpdateAudience

BuildUpdateKind.description: M5.9c Build Journey (m5.9c contract §2): a plain post, or a before/after pair whose two photos (before, then after) follow through POST build-updates/{id}/media and are paired in `photo_pairs`. Automatic entries and notes are `post`.
BuildUpdateKind.title: BuildUpdateKind

kind.description:
M5.9c Build Journey: `before_after` sets its one pair of `photo_pairs` side by side (before, after), with the mod of
`modifications` as its caption; `post` for everything else.

note.description: The owner's text: a note (up to 500 characters) or, since M4.11, a post (type `post`, up to 2,000, with @mentions).

summary.description: One line for lists: "Fahrwerk: Serie → KW V3 · −35 mm"

changes.description:
What happened, one entry per change. On lists at most 20, with details empty; the detail route has all of them, and
details holds field by field for a changed modification.

changes_count.description: How many changes the entry holds, also when a list shows fewer.

hidden.description: Always false for anybody but the owner, who alone sees hidden entries.

mileage_km.description: Kilometre reading the owner gave (UPD-01), else null.

happened_on.description: The day it happened (Y-m-d), default the day of posting.

audience.description: vehicle: whoever may see the vehicle; followers: only followers of the owner or the build (and the owner).

edited_at.description: Set when the owner changed the post after posting: the app shows "bearbeitet".

editable_until.description:
Owner only: until when text, photos and the rest can still be changed (24 hours after posting); null afterwards and for
automatic entries.

photos.description: Up to 10 photos in the owner's order. The owner sees unfinished and failed uploads too.

photo_pairs.description: Before/after pairs of the photos above, by media id.

modifications.description: Linked mods, in the owner's order (the mod row of VEH-02).

mentions.description: Members the text mentions whom the viewer may see; the app links "@name" in the text to them.

my_reaction.description: The viewer's own reaction [build_reactions]; null for guests, the owner, none yet, or the flag off. Never anybody else's.

reaction_summary.description: Owner only: reactions by kind and in total [build_reactions]. Missing for everybody else (09 §8.5).

type.description: What changed (BuildUpdateType): the app picks the row's glyph and the note/post layout by it (DQ-1093).

summary.description: One line: at most two changes, then "3 weitere".

media.description: M4.8: the update's own photos (ready, not rejected), in their order, with ThumbHash/blurhash placeholders.

viewer.description: M4.8: the reader's own state on this update (saved in a collection, their private reaction); null for guests.

Bundesland.description: M5.9b (contract §1): the 16 German states by their usual two-letter code. Spots, de_cities and users.bundesland store the code.
Bundesland.title: Bundesland

anyOf.description:
ADR-457 (amends 09 §5 BusinessCard): the card's 16:9 media. The business's own cover, else the cover of its newest portfolio
build (real builds first; lists prepare it), else null: the client then shows a brand-stage photo, never a glyph tile.

cover_source.description: Where `cover` comes from: "business" (its own), "portfolio" (a build from "Builds aus unserer Werkstatt"), null when none.

verified.description:
Staff verified the business (ADM-55): the Verifiziert badge. Never on a sample (DQ-1144, 09 §8.19): a fictional business
carries the "Beispiel" badge alone.

is_sample.description: Sample content (09 §8.19): the "Beispiel" badge.

distance_km.description: Kilometres from `lat`/`lng` of the list request, else null.

BusinessKind.description: What a business does, the first half of BIZ-01's "Werkstatt · München" line.
BusinessKind.title: BusinessKind

BusinessLegalForm.description: The legal form of BIZ-02 and the Impressum (§ 5 DDG). A register entry is expected for every form but the sole trader, the GbR and "other" (BusinessImpressum::needsRegister).
BusinessLegalForm.title: BusinessLegalForm

BusinessMediaRequest.description: Logo (square, shown at 56) or cover (16:9) of a business; re-encoded without metadata like every upload.

file.description: Type, size and pixels are checked by MediaService::inspectUpload (as for every upload).

plate_blur.description:
M5.9a "Kennzeichen unkenntlich machen": `1` pixelates `blur_regions` into the photo before any file is written (every
variant, OG image and share card comes from that master; the unblurred upload is deleted). `0`: the member switched it off.
Not sent: nothing is pixelated and the owner's plate check lists the photo. Shown to the owner only, as `plate_blur.state`.

blur_regions.description:
With `plate_blur=1`: 1–8 rectangles, normalised 0–1 from the top left of the photo as displayed (after EXIF orientation);
w and h at least 0.02, x + w and y + h at most 1. Optional `angle`: degrees clockwise about the rectangle's centre,
−45 to 45 (default 0), for a plate shot at an angle; the turned rectangle is pixelated. A JSON string (multipart) or an array.
Ignored otherwise.

distance_km.description: Kilometres from `lat`/`lng` of the list request, else null.

opening_hours.description: Monday first; `ranges` empty = closed; `today` in Europe/Berlin.

contact.description: `message_username`: "Nachricht" opens a conversation with this account (the business owner); null when it has no username.

portfolio_count.description: Real builds in "Builds aus unserer Werkstatt" (both sides confirmed; samples never count); null on a sample (09 §8.19).

impressum.description: § 5 DDG; on a sample its data is a placeholder (`is_sample`).

anyOf.description: The reader's role in the team ("owner", "staff"), null for everybody else: the app shows "Bearbeiten" and BIZ-03.

BusinessRole.description: Members of a business (09 §8.10 `business_members`): the owner (the applicant; one per business) manages the team and the profile; staff edit the profile and decide portfolio tags.
BusinessRole.title: BusinessRole

BusinessStatus.description: Business profiles (09 §8.10, ADR-414): applied (BIZ-02, waiting for ADM-55) → verified (public, badge) or rejected (with a reason; the applicant can change and send it again); a verified business can be suspended by staff (reason, audit, notice) and reinstated. Only a verified business is seen by anybody but its members and staff.

errors.description: Messages by field; empty when the error is not about one field.

reason.description: recipient_closed (Niemand, Following without a follow, a block either way, an account that is gone), not_verified, restricted.

CannotMessageReason.title: CannotMessageReason

day.description: The Europe/Berlin day of the pick, "2026-11-14" (published at 18:00).

story_line.description: The owner's line (≤ 140), at first the first sentence of their description; null without one.

is_sample.description: A sample build (staging and local only, never in production): the "Beispiel" badge.

can_vote_from.description: With account_too_new: when the account may vote.

candidates.description: In the Picker's order (position 1…3), never by votes.

code.description: With two-factor on: a current code from the authenticator app or a recovery code (SEC-P2-07).

password.description: 02_PRODUCT_SPEC §3.1: at least 10 characters, not common, not the address; not the username and not the current one.

code.description: With two-factor on: a current code from the authenticator app or a recovery code (SEC-P2-07).

variants.description: Signed for you, valid 10–20 minutes; read the message again for fresh ones.

restriction.description: Affected member only; restrict and suspend.

automated_detection.description: Art. 17(3)(c) DSA: automated means found the content.

automated_decision.description: Art. 17(3)(c) DSA: automated means took the decision (never so far: a person decides).

dispute_settlement_url.description: The European Commission's list of certified out-of-court dispute settlement bodies (Art. 21 DSA).

anyOf.description: Affected member only: community guidelines, terms or the law.

ground_section.description: Affected member only: the section of that document ("3"), for the link into SET-18.

statement.description: Affected member only: the decider's own words.

anyOf.description: The viewer's own appeal.

DecisionViewer.description: Who reads a decision (SAFE-01): the member it is about (the full statement of reasons) or a member who reported the case (the outcome only). Also the role of an appeal: both may complain (Art. 20(1) DSA).
DecisionViewer.title: DecisionViewer

DeleteAccountRequest.description: SET-13. `code` (authenticator or recovery code) is needed when two-factor is on; without it the answer is 422 on `code`.
DeleteAccountRequest.title: DeleteAccountRequest

text.description: At most 600 characters, from the vehicle's structured data only; every number in it stands in that data.

label.description: "KI-Vorschlag", shown until the member edits the text.

id.description: Opaque: "t…" for an app sign-in, "w…" for a browser. Send it to DELETE me/sessions/{id}.

device_name.description: What the device calls itself ("iPhone 15 Pro"), or browser and system ("Chrome auf macOS").

os_version.description: The system version the app last reported ("16" on Android, "26.1" on iOS); null for a browser.

approx_city.description: "München": approximate, only with a GeoLite2 database (owner action OA-33); null until then.

signed_in_at.description: ISO 8601. When this install first signed in; null for a browser.

DexSetKind.description: M5.9b (contract §1): the kinds of STREET DEX sets. jdm: a fixed list of generations (one slot each); brand: 5 / 10 / 25 cars of one make; city: 10 different cars in one city; season: cars spotted inside a month-day window of the current year.
DexSetKind.title: DexSetKind

window.description: Season sets: the month-day window, every year again; null for the others.

DigestFrequency.description: SET-09 "Zusammenfassung" (09 §7.12): how often the e-mail digest of unread messages may go out. Daily at 18:00 (Europe/Berlin), or weekly on Mondays at that time, covering everything that piled up since.
DigestFrequency.title: DigestFrequency

makes.description: Makes with at least one public build, most builds first, then by name.

collections.description: "Kollektionen": saved searches with at least one build the viewer can find, in the editors' order. Empty hides the section.

popular_mods.description: "Beliebte Mods": the chips of `home/modules`. Empty hides the section.

similar_members.description:
[SIG `sig.similar_builds`] "Mitglieder mit ähnlichen Autos", at most 8. Null for guests, a viewer without a public build,
no match, or the flag off: hide the section.

popular_models.description: M4.8 "Beliebte Modelle": at most 8 models with the most builds the reader may see. Empty hides the section.

weekend_events.description:
M4.8 "Treffen am Wochenende": at most 6 events of the coming Saturday and Sunday (Europe/Berlin), soonest first; empty while
`events` is off.

newest.description: M4.8 "Neu": the 8 newest builds the reader may see (as `home/new-builds`).

DistanceUnit.description: SET-11 "Entfernung" (09 §8.11): how the app shows distances and mileage. The server stores kilometres only.
DistanceUnit.title: DistanceUnit

resend_after_seconds.description: Seconds until a new code may be asked for.

resend_after.description: Seconds until the next code may be asked for (30, 60, then 120; longer during a lock or above 5 codes an hour).

errors.description: Messages by field; empty when the error is not about one field.

EmailOnlyRequest.description: Code requests: resend and forgot password.
EmailOnlyRequest.title: EmailOnlyRequest

status.description: Published or cancelled for everybody else; the organiser also sees draft, pending_review and rejected.

distance_km.description: From the `near` point to the area point, whole km; only when the list was asked with `near`.

EventLocationVisibility.title: EventLocationVisibility

is_sample.description: Sample content (09 §8.19): the app shows the "Beispiel" badge.

is_editorial.description: The Speedclub Editorial account, owner of the sample builds: the app shows the "Editorial" badge.

verified.description:
"Verifiziert" on the chip: a verified business or brand organiser (09 §8.10, M4.14). Always false until business profiles
and their verification exist; a member account is never verified.

status.description: pending · approved · rejected; everybody but the organiser and the uploader only ever reads approved.

reject_reason.description: Why the organiser turned it down; the uploader only.

is_sample.description: Seeded staging sample ("Beispiel" badge).

can.description:
What the reader may do: delete (own photo, or any as the organiser), report (somebody else's approved photo, through the
`photo` report target with `media.id`), moderate (the organiser, on a pending photo).

is_sample.description: 09 §8.19: a sample event ("Beispiel" badge).

status.description: Published or cancelled for everybody else; the organiser also sees draft, pending_review and rejected.

The place as far as this reader may see it (EventLocation): `exact` false means venue, street, postcode, lat and lng are
null and the app shows "Ort wird nach deiner Zusage angezeigt" with the city and the area point.

attendee_preview.description:
Up to three going members for the avatar row (09 §5 EventCard), by EVT-04's privacy rules: members only (empty for guests),
findable members, no block, never on a sample event. Next to `counts.going` for "38 Zusagen".

anyOf.description: The reader's own answer, null without one (and for guests).

organiser_rules.description: The organiser's own rules, shown under the community rules.

rules.description: The rules checklist the organiser accepted (legal_only always).

cancellation_reason.description: Why the event was cancelled; null unless cancelled.

cancelled_by_staff.description: Cancelled by staff rather than the organiser.

waitlist_position.description: Place on the waitlist (1 = next), only while the reader is waiting.

can.description:
What the reader may do now; the app shows only those actions. M5.6, only while their flag is on (otherwise the keys are absent): `add_photos` (the organiser, going or checked-in members
while the gallery is open, not under a publishing restriction), `moderate_photos` (the organiser), `checkin` (a member who
may check in now and has not), `show_checkin_code` (the organiser while the check-in window is open).

checkin.description:
M5.6 check-in (flag events.checkin; absent while it is off, and for unpublished and sample events). The window runs from
60 min before the start to 120 min after the end; `mine` is the reader's own check-in; `count` the organiser's only.

review.description:
The organiser's review state: submitted_at, reviewed_at and the reason of a rejection. `will_be_reviewed` (a draft or a
rejected event): sending it goes to the team's review first (the first events, every after_rsvp event), so EVT-03 says
"Zur Prüfung senden" rather than "Veröffentlichen". `was_premoderated` (a published event): the team approved it before it
went live. Null for everybody else.

calendar_url.description:
"In Kalender": an .ics URL. For the organiser and going members of an after_rsvp event a signed link with the exact place
(valid until two days after the end); otherwise the public file with the area only.

waitlist_position.description: Place on the waitlist (1 = next) while waiting; null otherwise.

spots_left.description: Spots left while a capacity is set; null without a limit and on samples.

EventRule.description: The rules checklist of EVT-03 (09 §8.7 "Rules & law", the events section of the community guidelines). legal_only is required on every event; the organiser ticks the others that apply. Shown as "Regeln" on EVT-02 next to the organiser's own rules.
EventRule.title: EventRule

EventStatus.description: 09 §8.7: draft → pending_review (pre-moderation, ADM-53) or published → cancelled; rejected by staff (or removed by a moderation decision). Only published and cancelled events are seen by anybody but their organiser and staff.
EventStatus.title: EventStatus

EventType.description: The kind of a meet (09 §8.7, EVT-01 filter "Art"): Treffen · Ausfahrt · Trackday · Messe.
EventType.title: EventType

EventVisibility.description: Who sees an event (09 §8.7): public (listed for everybody), followers (the organiser's followers, not listed for others) or unlisted (by link only, never listed).
EventVisibility.title: EventVisibility

value.description: The parameter value: a slug ("bmw"), an enum value ("rear"), a diameter ("19.5") or a category key.

label.description: Ready to show, in the request's language: "BMW", "Heck", "19,5″", "Räder & Reifen".

count.description: Builds with this value and every other active filter (disjunctive). 0 only for an active value.

total.description: Builds with every active filter; stops at 1000 (`total_capped`).

makes.description: Most builds first, then by name.

models.description: Models of the active make; null without `make`.

generations.description: Generations of the active model, oldest first; null without `model`.

wheel_diameter.description: Ascending; front and rear sizes of every installed wheel set.

wheel_brand.description: The 20 brands with the most builds, plus active ones.

suspension_brand.description: The 20 brands with the most builds, plus active ones.

exhaust_brand.description: The 20 brands with the most builds, plus active ones.

mod_category.description: Categories with an installed mod, in the categories' order.

year.description: Model years of the builds the other filters leave; null when none has one.

power.description: PS of the builds the other filters leave; null when none has a figure.

errors.description: Messages by field; empty when the error is not about one field.

source.description: `editorial` from the curated list, `completeness` when the list left the slot empty.

quote.description: M4.9: the owner's own first sentence of the description (HOME-01 lead), or null; never invented.

FeaturedSource.description: Why a build is in the featured slot of HOME-01: named by the editorial list (speedclub.home.featured_slugs, later ADM), or picked as one of the most complete public builds when the list leaves a slot empty.
FeaturedSource.title: FeaturedSource

key.description: Stable over pages and reloads, for list keys: "vehicle:01k…", "update:01k…".

next_cursor.description: Pass as `cursor` for the next page; null at the end.

suggestions.description:
"Folge ich" only, and only when its first page is empty: up to 6 members to follow, with a build like one of the
reader's, else active members. Null otherwise.

errors.description: Messages by field; empty when the error is not about one field.

FeedTab.description: The segments of HOME-01: "Für dich" (ranked, guests too) and "Folge ich" (chronological, members only).
FeedTab.title: FeedTab

eyebrow.description: "NISSAN". Null while a draft has no make.

make.description: Catalogue name or free text. Null while a draft has no make.

model.description: Catalogue name or free text. Null while a draft has no model.

spec_strip.description: Four columns: power and torque in the viewer's units, model year, drivetrain. value is null until entered.

updates_count.description: M4.9: the owner's own count of Verlauf entries (hidden ones included); null for anybody else, so no number reaches others.

is_sample.description: Sample content (09 §8.19): the app shows the "Beispiel" badge.

build_score.description:
M5.9c: the Build Score (0–1000) and its stage (1–5), for GAR-01 and the cards; null until it was first computed. Ranks and
parts are on GET vehicles/{id}/build-score.

wizard.description: Where a draft resumes: "Entwurf · Schritt 2 von 4". Null for anything but the owner's draft.

qr.description: Owner only. The vehicle's active code, from its first publish on.

anyOf.description:
The owner row. Null for everybody but the owner when the owner asked not to be named on the vehicle page
(`show_owner_on_qr`, ADR-148 a), so a card does not name who the page itself hides.

latest_update.description: The newest entry of Verlauf that is not hidden, in one line: "Fahrwerk: Serie → KW V3 · −35 mm".

viewer.description:
M4.8: the reader's own state on this build: saved in one of their collections, their private reaction
("strong" | "clean" | "low" | "loud", null while build_reactions is off). Null for guests. Never anybody else's, never a count.

comment_thread.description:
R5-5 [build_comments]: the car's own comment thread, so a card can open it in place. enabled: the thread is open (flag on,
the owner allows comments); can_write: this reader may write now (false for guests). Never a count.

followers.description: Null after unfollowing somebody you cannot see, and for a sample member (09 §8.19).

errors.description: Messages by field; empty when the error is not about one field.

ForumCategoryKind.description: M5.8 (m5.8-contract §1): an admin-managed category, a sub-category generated per catalogue make ("Marken & Modelle") or one per Bundesland ("Treffen & Regionen").
ForumCategoryKind.title: ForumCategoryKind

kind.description: standard · make (one per catalogue make, under "Marken & Modelle") · region (one per Bundesland, under "Treffen & Regionen").

icon.description: Phosphor icon key for the chip, or null.

children.description: Active sub-categories in their order (top-level categories of the tree only; empty for a sub-category).

status.description: published; the author also sees pending ("In Prüfung"), rejected and removed.

body.description: The Markdown source, only for the author (to edit); null otherwise.

content.description:
The text as a tree the app renders natively (Markdown subset, ForumMarkdown). A block is a `paragraph` with `children`, or a
`list` (`ordered`, `start` for an ordered list, else null) whose `items` are lists of blocks (paragraphs, nested lists). An
inline is `text` (`text`, `bold`, `italic`), `link` (`href`, http/https only, with `children`: text spans) or `break` (a line
break). Nothing else occurs; no HTML.

review_reason.description: Why the team did not publish it: a rejected post of the reader's own; null otherwise.

deleted.description: A deleted reply kept as the head of its answers: no author, no text.

mentions.description: Members the post mentions whom the reader may see.

replies.description: Answers to a top-level reply, oldest first (empty for an answer).

ForumPostSort.description: FOR-03 replies: in the order they were written, or the most "Hilfreich" first (10 §7.2: the count is visible to sort answers).
ForumPostSort.title: ForumPostSort

ForumPostStatus.description: M5.8 (m5.8-contract §1): a post (a thread's opening post or a reply) waits for pre-moderation, is published, was rejected there, or was removed by a DSA decision (reversible on appeal). Deleting by its author is a soft delete.
ForumPostStatus.title: ForumPostStatus

path.description: "/forum/{id}".

status.description: published for everybody; the author also sees pending ("In Prüfung"), rejected, removed and merged threads on FOR-05.

anyOf.description: Null for a deleted account, or one the reader may no longer see.
The attached build while the reader may see it.

replies_count.description: Published replies (shown in the forum only).

anyOf.description: Who wrote the newest reply, while the reader may see them; null before the first reply.

path.description: "/forum/{id}" (FOR-03).

opening_post_id.description: The opening post: report the thread with it. Null when its author's account is gone.

body.description: The Markdown source of the opening post, only for the author (to edit).

content.description:
The opening post as a tree the app renders natively (Markdown subset, ForumMarkdown). A block is a `paragraph` with `children`, or a
`list` (`ordered`, `start` for an ordered list, else null) whose `items` are lists of blocks (paragraphs, nested lists). An
inline is `text` (`text`, `bold`, `italic`), `link` (`href`, http/https only, with `children`: text spans) or `break` (a line
break). Nothing else occurs; no HTML.

opening_deleted.description: The opening post's author deleted their account: the title stays, the text is gone (m5.8-contract D8).

photos.description: Up to 6 photos, in their order (finished ones; the author also sees those still processing).

modification.description: The attached mod while the reader may see it.

anyOf.description: The reply marked "Gelöst", while the reader may see it.
Status merged: the thread its replies moved to; the app opens it instead.

review_reason.description: Why staff did not publish it (rejected; the author only).

share_url.description: Opens FOR-03 in the member web (share sheet).

ai_summary.description:
M5.9 (ai.forum_summary): three short lines on a published thread with more than 20 replies, labelled "KI-Zusammenfassung";
null otherwise, without a provider key, and for a reader with a block on an author whose posts went into it.

status.description: published for everybody; the author also sees pending ("In Prüfung"), rejected, removed and merged threads on FOR-05.

anyOf.description: Null for a deleted account, or one the reader may no longer see.
The attached build while the reader may see it.

replies_count.description: Published replies (shown in the forum only).

anyOf.description: Who wrote the newest reply, while the reader may see them; null before the first reply.

path.description: "/forum/{id}" (FOR-03).

ForumThreadSort.description: FOR-01/02 sort chips (10 §7.2): Aktiv (pinned first, then the newest activity), Neu (newest publication), Unbeantwortet (no published reply yet, newest first), Gelöst (a marked solution, newest activity first).
ForumThreadSort.title: ForumThreadSort

ForumThreadStatus.description: M5.8 (m5.8-contract §1): a thread waits for pre-moderation (new or unverified accounts), is published, was rejected in pre-moderation (its author still sees it with the reason), removed by a DSA decision (reversible on appeal) or merged into another thread. Deleting by its author is a soft delete.
ForumThreadStatus.title: ForumThreadStatus

GalleryPhotoSource.description: M5.6 (m5.6-contract §4.1): who added a photo to an event's gallery. The organiser's photos publish at once, an attendee's wait for the organiser's approval.
GalleryPhotoSource.title: GalleryPhotoSource

year_to.description: Null while it is still built.

GoogleSignInRequest.description: POST auth/google (09 §8.1): the ID token of the Google SDK or Google Identity Services; nonce when the client passed one to Google.

nonce.description: SEC-M46-05: the raw nonce from POST auth/nonce that was given to the Google SDK; single use.

device_id.description: The app's per-install id (a UUID kept in secure storage). Tells two devices of the same model apart; ignored without device_name.

os_version.description: M4.7 (09 §8.4): the system version, for SET-06 ("Android 16").

invite_code.description: The code of /join/{code} (8 characters Crockford; I/L read as 1, O as 0). Optional; an invalid code is ignored, never refused.

GoogleSignInRequest.title: GoogleSignInRequest

GroundDocument.description: Where the ground of a decision is written (Art. 17(3)(d), (e) DSA): the community guidelines, the terms (both legal documents of SET-18) or the law alone.
GroundDocument.title: GroundDocument

locale.description: The language of the text: de when the requested language has no own version.

HighlightItemType.description: What an owner can pin to a vehicle's Highlights rail (09 §8.5): a build update or a photo of the build. The value is what the API and the table use.
HighlightItemType.title: HighlightItemType

anyOf.description: Set for type build_update.
Set for type photo.

M5.9d "Car of the Day" (ADR-510): Home's lead module from 18:00 to the next day's 18:00; null before the first pick, on a
skipped day and when the reader may not see the car.

M4.8 "Build der Woche": one build per ISO week (best ranked of the two weeks before), the hero left out; null when none
and (M5.9d) while it is the Car of the Day.

nearby_events.description:
M4.8 "Treffen in deiner Nähe": at most 2 upcoming events within 50 km of `lat`/`lng` (asked on demand, never stored); empty
without a point or while `events` is off: hide the module.

brands_in_focus.description:
M4.8 "Marken im Fokus": at most 3 part brands most run on builds the reader may see. Empty hides the module.
(`workshops_nearby` joins with business profiles, M4.14.)

build_updates.description:
Deprecated since M4.8 (the 2.0 Home has no Build-Updates module; these updates are in the stream too).
At most 3, newest first; at most one per build and two per owner.

active_members.description: At most 12, most recently active first.

IdTokenNonceRequest.description: POST auth/nonce (SEC-M46-05): which provider the nonce is for.
IdTokenNonceRequest.title: IdTokenNonceRequest

nonce.description: Give it to the provider SDK (Apple: its SHA-256 hex), then send it unchanged with the ID token. Single use.

errors.description: Messages by field; empty when the error is not about one field.

IllegalSubReason.description: The kind of illegal content (m2.6-contract §1): glorifying or organising street racing (§ 315d StGB), hate speech, privacy (doxxing), copyright (stolen photos), anything else that is against the law.
IllegalSubReason.title: IllegalSubReason

scope.description: `account` (GET me/insights: the profile and every car) or `vehicle` (GET vehicles/{id}/insights).

anyOf.description: The car of the vehicle scope (VehicleRefResource); null for the account.

counting_since.description:
The first day with counting for this scope (Y-m-d); null before any view was counted. "Zählung seit …" when
                 it falls inside the 30 days.

headline.description: Plain-language sentence in the reader's language, e.g. "Dein E46 wurde diese Woche 128-mal angesehen – 31 % mehr als letzte Woche."

views.description:
Views of the last 7 Berlin days (incl. today) and the 7 before. `delta_percent` is null while the previous week had fewer than
5 views; `trend` up|down|same|new ("new": nothing the week before).

days.description: Exactly 30 days, oldest first, zeros included: unique viewers and raw sticker scans per day.

sources.description: All four sources over the 30 days, most views first; `percent` (floor) null without views.

sticker_scans.description: Raw scans of the scope's stickers (as STK-04); null when no car of the scope ever had a sticker.

spots.description: Counted STREET DEX spots of the scope's cars.

follows.description: New followers that still follow: of the member (account scope only, else null) and of the cars.

saves.description: Saves of the scope's cars (still saved).

reactions.description: The private reactions on the scope's cars and their build updates; `by_type` this week, all four types, most first.

breakdown.description: Account scope only (else []): the profile and every published car with its views of the last 7 days.

InstallModificationRequest.description: M5.3 "Als verbaut markieren" (m5.3-contract §4.2). Both keys are optional: the month defaults to the current one in Germany.

installed_on.description: Month of installation as YYYY-MM, not in the future; the current month (Europe/Berlin) when left out.

cost_cents.description: What it cost in the end. Private, always: only the owner reads it (09 §11). Unchanged when left out.

InstallModificationRequest.title: InstallModificationRequest

q.description: The search as typed, e.g. "schwarze M4 mit KW V3 und 19 Zoll".

value.description: A slug, a diameter ("19.5"), or a range "min-max" for year ("2004-2004") and power ("500-"), as the app's chip ids.

label.description: Ready to show, in the request's language.

matched.description: The typed words this chip came from ("e46"); null when it follows from another chip (the make of "m4").

filters.description: Under the parameter names of `search/vehicles`, only what was understood.

chips.description: One per understood filter: make, model, generation, year, power, wheel_diameter, in this order.

remaining_q.description: The words that were not understood, as typed; empty when everything was.

errors.description: Messages by field; empty when the error is not about one field.

code.description: 8 characters Crockford; the link is https://<host>/join/{code}.

accepted_at.description: When somebody activated an account with it; null while open.

title.description: The level's title in the request's language.

LinkProviderRequest.description: POST me/providers: a fresh ID token of the provider and the raw nonce from POST auth/nonce it was made with (SEC-M46-05).
LinkProviderRequest.title: LinkProviderRequest

device_id.description: The app's per-install id (a UUID kept in secure storage). Tells two devices of the same model apart; ignored without device_name.

os_version.description: M4.7 (09 §8.4): the system version, for SET-06 ("Android 16").

currency.description: Always "EUR": the server keeps euro cents.

years.description: Newest year first; only years with a cost.

MaintenanceDueState.description: Where an item stands (MNT-01 ring and countdown): nothing due known, fine, inside its first lead time (or 1,000 km), or past due.
MaintenanceDueState.title: MaintenanceDueState

title.description: Custom items only; the app names the other types itself.

date.description: YYYY-MM-DD; the first day of the month for the HU/AU.

month.description: HU/AU only: the month on the plakette, "2027-03".

pinned.description: The member set the date or mileage (service booklet); a new log entry computes it again.

deadline.description: The last day before it counts as overdue (the end of the HU/AU month).

season.description: Tyre change: which tyres go on next.

days_left.description: Days to the due date, negative once past it.

km_left.description: Kilometres to the due mileage, negative once past it; null without a due mileage or a known odometer.

progress.description: 0–1, how much of the interval has passed (the ring), or null.

reminders.description: The reminder stages of the current due date (09 §8.8 "server + local dedupe"): `key` is the id of the local backup notification.

version.description: Send it back with a PATCH: a newer one on the server answers 409 edit_conflict.

business_id.description: M4.14: the linked business profile; null until business profiles exist.

details.description:
By type, language-free. Named details, not data: Laravel (and the export) leave a single resource unwrapped when its
body already has a key "data". followed_published: {kind: "vehicle"|"update", update_id, vehicles, updates} (kind of the latest
event; how many builds were published and updates posted that day). build_saved: {count, week} ("2026-W45"). security:
{event: "new_device"|"password_changed"|"email_changed"|"two_factor_changed"|"deletion_requested"|"sessions_revoked"|"verification_failed"|"recovery_code_used", device_name, security_event_id (M4.7: the SET-21 row of a login alert, else null)}.
new_follower: {}. moderation_decision (a decision about the reader's content or account): {decision_id, action:
"remove_content"|"restrict"|"suspend"}. report_decided (the outcome of a case the reader reported): {decision_id, outcome:
"no_action"|"remove_content"|"measures"}, never the measure. SAFE-01 opens the decision.
qr_milestone [SIG]: {milestone: 10|50|100|500|1000}, total scans of the vehicle's stickers; STK-02 opens. hu_au_reminder [SIG]:
{due: "2027-03"}, the month the HU/AU is due; GAR-06 opens. catalog_request (M3.3): {outcome: "accepted"|"rejected", requested:
the make and model the member typed, reason: why it was declined (rejected only), else null}; the vehicle is the member's own.
support_reply (Phase 3): {ticket_id, reference: "SC-7H2KQXMB"}, the team answered that support request; SET-15b opens the
thread. Never the text of the answer. M4.11: reaction {target: "vehicle"|"build_update", update_id} (the owner's own item;
actors are who reacted, never how), mention {target, update_id, comment_id} (comment_id null for a mention in the update itself),
comment [build_comments] {target, update_id, comment_id (the newest), reply: a reply to the reader's comment}, where R5-5's
target is "vehicle" for the car's own comment thread (update_id null; VEH-01 opens with its comments) and "build_update"
otherwise, vehicle_follower {}
(vehicle is the reader's build). update_id is null once the reader may no longer see the update; the row then opens the build.
M4.12 (the event is in `event`): event_review {outcome: "approved"|"rejected", reason (rejected only)}, event_promoted {} (the
reader moved from the waitlist to going), event_reminder {kind: "24h"|"2h"}, event_update {kind: "update"|"changed" (time or
place changed), update_id}, event_cancelled {by_staff}. Never the text of an update. M4.13 maintenance_due (vehicle: the
reader's own): {kind: "date"|"km", item_id, item_type, due_on (YYYY-MM-DD) or due_km, lead_days, reminder_key (the id of the
app's local backup notification, also in the push data)}; MNT-01 opens. M4.14 (in-app only): business_review {outcome:
"verified"|"rejected"|"suspended"|"reinstated"|"reopened" (SEC-414-03: a verified business went back to review), business_id, reason (rejected and suspended only)}, BIZ-03 opens; business_tag
{state: "requested"|"accepted"|"declined", side: "business" (the business must act or hears back; BIZ-04 opens) | "member" (the
build's owner; VEH-02 opens), tag_id, business_id, mod_id} (vehicle: the build of the mod). SEC-414-01 business_invite
{state: "invited"|"removed" (side "member": a business invited the reader to its team, open it with GET me/business-invites;
or removed them) | "accepted"|"declined"|"left" (side "business": the member answered or left; BIZ-03 opens), business_id,
invite_id (invited only; the id for POST me/business-invites/{invite}/accept), username (the other side)}. M5.9b spot_alert (vehicle: the
reader's own car; DEX-06 opens): {day: "YYYY-MM-DD" (Europe/Berlin), count (counted spots that day), cities_count (cities of the
day's day spots; 0 for night-only days and while the car hides its cities), city (the name when cities_count is 1, else null)};
"Dein EK9 wurde heute 4-mal in Düsseldorf gespottet." Never who spotted it. M5.8 (the thread is in `forum_thread`): forum_reply
{thread_id, post_id (the newest reply), reply_to: "thread" (in the reader's thread or subscription) | "post" (to the reader's
post)}, forum_mention {thread_id, post_id}, forum_solved {thread_id, post_id (the reader's reply marked as the solution)}.
M5.6 (the event is in `event`): event_gallery_pending {count (attendee photos waiting for the reader's approval today)};
event_photo_decided {outcome: "approved"|"rejected", photo_id} (in-app only; the reason is on EVT-02); event_nearby {count, week
("2026-W47"), event_ids (soonest first; `event` is the first)}, "Neue Treffen in deiner Nähe"; EVT-01 opens.
M5.7 plan_due {modification_id, target_month: "2026-11"} (vehicle: the reader's own; VEH-01 Pläne opens), "Ist das KW V3 schon
             * verbaut?"; weekly_recap {week: "2026-11-16" (Monday), views, sticker_scans, new_followers, spots, events_nearby,
maintenance_due}, counts only; INS-01 opens. R4-2.3 crew (in-app only): {state: "request_received" (to founder/admins; the
crew's requests open) | "request_approved" (CREW-01 opens) | "invited" (GET me/crew-invites; invite_id for POST
me/crew-invites/{invite}/accept), crew_id, crew_slug, crew_name, username (requester or inviter; null for request_approved),
invite_id, request_id}.

NotificationType.description: The rows of the notification list (02_PRODUCT_SPEC §7). Written by App\Services\Notifications\Notifier only; later modules add their types here (M2.4 messages and requests, M2.6 decisions, M2.7 QR milestones and HU/AU).
NotificationType.title: NotificationType

km.description: The mileage now, in km (the app converts mi).

OnboardingStep.description: The first open step of F1, where the app resumes after a restart.
OnboardingStep.title: OnboardingStep

(with or without `muted: true`) mutes until then; `{muted: false}` or `{muted_until: null}` unmutes.

muted.description: True mutes: with no end unless muted_until names one. False unmutes and takes no muted_until.

muted_until.description: Muted until this moment (ISO 8601), at most a year ahead. Null without `muted: true` unmutes.

synced.description: Synced across the member's devices (backup state of the credential).

Pixelated into the master before any public file was made, at upload or later with GAR-08. | | `declined`
The member said there is nothing to hide: uploaded with the switch off, or "Kein Kennzeichen sichtbar" in the plate check. | | `unchecked`
Uploaded before M5.9a or by a client that does not send the switch: the one-time "Kennzeichen prüfen" lists it. |

decision.description: `keep`: "Kein Kennzeichen sichtbar". Pixelating goes through `PATCH media/{media}` with `blur_regions`.

category_key.description: The mod category most of its mods are in ("suspension"), for the chip's icon.

query.description: What DISC-02 searches for when the chip is tapped (`q`).

PreviewStickerRequest.description: POST vehicles/{vehicle}/sticker-design/preview: an unsaved state of the editor, rendered and never stored.
PreviewStickerRequest.title: PreviewStickerRequest

label.description: "KI-Vorschlag" when the AI normalised the text; null when the catalogue matched the words directly.

normalized.description: The catalogue words the AI made of the text, e.g. "KW Variant 3"; null without the AI.

products.description: At most 3 active catalogue products; empty when nothing matches (the app offers "Nicht gefunden?").

builds.description:
Visible real builds with this product (samples never count, DQ-1140; 0 = hide the number); null where the list does not
count (the editor's autocomplete).

anyOf.description:
ADR-457: the cover of the newest real public build with this product (1:1 thumbnail at radius 8); null when there is none
(the client shows the category glyph) or the list does not count (the editor's autocomplete).

attributes.description: Key attributes from the catalogue, in the reader's language (German where the catalogue has no English).

affiliate.description: Only while affiliate_links is on and the product has one: show `label` next to the link and set `rel`.

builds.description:
Visible real builds with this product (samples never count, DQ-1140; 0 = hide the number); null where the list does not
count (the editor's autocomplete).

anyOf.description:
ADR-457: the cover of the newest real public build with this product (1:1 thumbnail at radius 8); null when there is none
(the client shows the category glyph) or the list does not count (the editor's autocomplete).

ProductStatus.description: Products of the parts catalogue (09 §8.9, ADM-57): active ones are listed, searched and linkable in the mod editor; archived ones stay on the mods that link them (their name still shows) but leave search and the brand pages.
ProductStatus.title: ProductStatus

ProposeTagRequest.description: BIZ-03 Portfolio "Build markieren": the mod the business built (on a public build); its owner confirms.
ProposeTagRequest.title: ProposeTagRequest

status.description: Published or cancelled for everybody else; the organiser also sees draft, pending_review and rejected.

location.description:
The place as far as this reader may see it (EventLocation): `exact` false means venue, street, postcode, lat and lng are
null and the app shows "Ort wird nach deiner Zusage angezeigt" with the city and the area point.

counts.description: Real answers, members taken off the list left out; null on a sample event (09 §8.19: no invented counts).

spots_left.description: Spots left while a capacity is set (0 = new answers join the waitlist); null without a limit and on samples.

distance_km.description: From the `near` point to the area point, whole km; only when the list was asked with `near`.

attendee_preview.description:
Up to three going members for the avatar row (09 §5 EventCard), by EVT-04's privacy rules: members only (empty for guests),
findable members, no block, never on a sample event. Next to `counts.going` for "38 Zusagen".

eyebrow.description: "NISSAN". Null while a draft has no make.

make.description: Catalogue name or free text. Null while a draft has no make.

model.description: Catalogue name or free text. Null while a draft has no model.

spec_strip.description: Four columns: power and torque in the viewer's units, model year, drivetrain. value is null until entered.

is_sample.description: Sample content (09 §8.19): the app shows the "Beispiel" badge.

build_score.description:
M5.9c: the Build Score (0–1000) and its stage (1–5), for GAR-01 and the cards; null until it was first computed. Ranks and
parts are on GET vehicles/{id}/build-score.

wizard.description: Where a draft resumes: "Entwurf · Schritt 2 von 4". Null for anything but the owner's draft.

qr.description: Owner only. The vehicle's active code, from its first publish on.

canonical_url.description: The web page of this vehicle, for sharing: the canonical address (no redirect for a link preview), HTTPS where the site is.

share_url.description:
M5.7: the address the share sheet uses: the canonical one with `?via=share`, so a view through it counts as "geteilter Link"
in the owner's statistics (canonical, OG and JSON-LD stay on the plain address).

dex_number.description: M5.9b STREET DEX: the car's Dex number ("Nr. 0087"), public like on the share card and DEX-04; null for a draft.

power.description: "510 PS (375 kW)" in the viewer's setting, what was entered, and the provenance label.

spec_groups.description: The tables of the Technik tab: Fahrzeug, Motor, Leistung, Antrieb.

highlights_rail.description:
M4.9 VEH-01 "Highlights": the owner's pinned rail (build updates and photos, in their order) the reader may see. `highlights`
above stays the top mods per category for older apps.

mods.description: Groups by category, in the order of the catalogue. count is what "Alle Mods (14)" shows.

plans.description:
M5.3 "Pläne" (10 §5.9): the planned mods in the owner's order (PUT vehicles/{id}/plans/order). They stay in `mods` too, for
apps before 2.1 and WEB-01; the 2.1 app leaves status `planned` out of its Mods section. The budget is the owner's alone.

build_progress.description:
M5.3 Build-Fortschritt (10 §6.2): built ÷ (built + planned), from the rows above alone (installed and planned; removed parts
are not part of the build). Null without either. Same audience as the page: no money, no social counts.

build_goal.description:
M5.7 (10 §6.2): the owner's optional milestone goal, shown with the Build-Fortschritt ("Ziel: Saison 2027"); `passed` once its
year is over (the app shows a passed goal to the owner only). Null when not set.

updates.description: The latest entries of Verlauf; the rest through public/vehicles/{slug}/updates.

anyOf.description:
Null for everybody but the owner when the owner asked not to be named on the page a sticker leads to (`show_owner_on_qr`
off). This is that page, whether reached by a scan, a link or the app, as WEB-01 is.

share_card_url.description:
[SIG sig.share_cards] The VEH-07 share cards, PNG, 1080 × 1920 (`story`) and 1080 × 1080 (`square`), immutable: the URL changes
with what the card shows. A format is null while it is being drawn (it is queued then), for a private build (its card is
never stored) and without a usable photo: GET vehicles/{id}/share-card.png?format= draws it at once. Null while the flag is off.

is_saved.description: The viewer saved this build [SIG sig.saved_builds]. Null for guests, for the owner and while the flag is off.

social.description:
M4.11 (09 §8.5, §8.6): the viewer's own reaction and build follow. Counts (reactions by kind, followers) only for the owner;
nobody else ever receives them. Each part is null while its flag is off.

comment_thread.description:
R5-5 [build_comments]: the car's own comment thread on VEH-01 (GET/POST vehicles/{id}/comments). enabled: the thread is
open (flag on, the owner allows comments); can_write: this reader may write now (false for guests). Never a count.

visibility.description: The choice of wizard step 4. Without it the draft keeps what it has, public by default.

public_url.description: The page a scan leads to, for "Öffentliche Seite ansehen".

anyOf.description: What a stranger gets when scanning it right now: `active`, `private` or `revoked`.

downloads.description:
Null unless the code is active: a revoked sticker cannot be printed again. With a cookie session these are plain links; a
native client sends its bearer token.

title.description:
"Dieser QR-Code ist nicht mehr gültig", or for a revoked code whose vehicle or account was deleted "Dieses Fahrzeug ist nicht
             * mehr verfügbar"; null when `state` is `active`.

QrScanState.description: What a scan of a code leads to (WEB-06, 02_PRODUCT_SPEC §3.4, F4).
QrScanState.title: QrScanState

days.description: Exactly 30 entries since M4.9 (14 before), oldest first. `date` is YYYY-MM-DD in German time.

total.description: Since the vehicle's first code, over all its codes.

milestones_reached.description: The milestones of the in-app `qr_milestone` notification the total has reached, ascending: of 10, 50, 100, 500, 1000.

Rarity.description: M5.9b STREET DEX (10 §16.2, contract §1, §6): the rarity tier of a car. Highest applicable wins: ghost > legend > rare > tuned > street. Ghost is the owner's opt-in (vehicles.ghost_mode) and overrides whatever was computed; the thresholds live in config/speedclub.php `dex.rarity` (App\Services\Dex\RarityRules).
Rarity.title: Rarity

rare.description: Rare: at most this many public cars of the same generation.

legend.description: Legend: Build Score at least, or the only public car of its generation.

errors.description: Messages by field; empty when the error is not about one field.

target_type.description: vehicles or build-updates, as in the path.

ReactionType.description: Private reactions on builds and build updates (09 §8.5, ADR-413): Gefällt mir · Stark · Sauber · Tief · Laut, one per member and item. "Gefällt mir" (client round 4, 11 R4-2.2) is the one-tap heart the app shows first; the others are the car reactions behind it. The app draws them with its own glyphs. Counts reach the owner only, never anybody else.
ReactionType.title: ReactionType

reason.description: Shown to everybody with an answer on EVT-02.

ReauthMethod.description: How POST me/reauth proves the member again (09 §8.1 "sudo mode").
ReauthMethod.title: ReauthMethod

POST me/reauth. passkey: ceremony_id + credential; email_code: attempt_id + code; password: password. two_factor_code with two-factor
on for email_code and password.

RecordViewRequest.description: POST views (m5.7-contract §3.1): the app's view beacon, once per screen focus of VEH-01 or PROF-02 that is not the viewer's own.

RedressOption.title: RedressOption

anyOf.description: Where sign-up began, when it began on a QR scan or a public page (ADR-216): qr, public_vehicle, public_profile.

invite_code.description: The code of /join/{code} (8 characters Crockford; I/L read as 1, O as 0). Optional; an invalid code is ignored, never refused.

date.description: YYYY-MM-DD, the day the release reached members.

items.description: What is new, one sentence each.

PUT me/collections/order (ids of collections) and PUT me/collections/{id}/items/order (items as "type:id"), first = top. Must name
every entry exactly once; the controller checks that against what is stored.
ReorderRequest.title: ReorderRequest

ReportTargetType.title: ReportTargetType

errors.description: Messages by field; empty when the error is not about one field.

base_revision.description: The revision the app last saw of the current version (0 before the first save). Review MF-4.

device_id.description: The app's per-install id, as sent at sign-in. Taken only by a token that has none yet (an older app build's).

app_version.description: M4.7 (09 §8.4): the app and system version now, so SET-06 shows them after an update.

status.description: going ("Zusagen"; the waitlist when full) or interested.

base_revision.description: The revision the app last saw (`revision` of the design; 0 before the first save). Review MF-4.

SaveStickerDesignRequest.title: SaveStickerDesignRequest

target_month.description: M5.3: the target month of a plan as YYYY-MM; null for a mod that is not planned or a plan without one.

is_due.description: M5.3: a plan whose target month has come (Europe/Berlin); false for anything else.

anyOf.description: M5.3: optional priority of a plan.

plan_sort.description: M5.3: the owner's order of the plans (PUT vehicles/{id}/plans/order); null for a mod that is not planned.

budget.description: M5.3: the planned budget, the owner's alone like `cost` (never another member, a guest, a public page or staff in view-as).

cost_public.description: Always false since M4.9 (09 §11, ADR ruling): costs are never public. Kept for older apps.

cost.description: The owner's alone (never another member, a guest, a public page or staff in view-as).

legal_status.description: Null while the flag sig.mod_legal_status is off.

is_registered.description:
M5.9c "TÜV-eingetragen": the owner states the mod is entered in the vehicle papers (legal_status registered or
individual_approval). The owner's statement, never our judgement; false while sig.mod_legal_status is off.

product.description:
M4.14 (09 §8.9): the linked catalogue product, so the Mods tab links BRD-02 and the brand links BRD-01; null without one and
while parts_catalogue is off. `brand_slug` repeats `brand.slug` for older apps.

installed_by.description:
M4.14 (09 §8.10): "Eingebaut von", only once the business and the owner both confirmed the tag and the reader may see the
business; null otherwise and while businesses is off. `verified` is never true on a sample business (DQ-1144).

notes.description: The owner's, null for anybody else (ADR-142).

specs.description: Labelled rows of the category, in the viewer's language and number format.

fields.description: The stored values, for the owner's form.

legal_disclaimer.description: "Angaben des Besitzers, keine rechtliche Prüfung", when a legal status is shown.

failed_photos.description:
Owner only, empty for anybody else (ADR-181 revisit, M2.7): photos of this mod whose upload failed for good, shown on GAR-10 as
GAR-07 shows a vehicle's, delete only (DELETE media/{id}); media:prune removes them after 30 days. Never in `photos`.

search.description:
The DISC-02 filter values of this part, for "Ähnliche suchen" on VEH-02 (M2.3): open `search/vehicles` with them. A brand
only when it is a catalogue brand, the diameter only for wheels, type only for suspension.

business_tag.description: The owner's alone (null for anybody else): the state of the tag while it waits or after the business declined it.

history_recorded.description: Whether Verlauf now tells about this edit. Decides between "Gespeichert" and "Im Verlauf erscheint ein Eintrag".

eyebrow.description: "NISSAN". Null while a draft has no make.

make.description: Catalogue name or free text. Null while a draft has no make.

model.description: Catalogue name or free text. Null while a draft has no model.

spec_strip.description: Four columns: power and torque in the viewer's units, model year, drivetrain. value is null until entered.

updates_count.description: M4.9: the owner's own count of Verlauf entries (hidden ones included); null for anybody else, so no number reaches others.

is_sample.description: Sample content (09 §8.19): the app shows the "Beispiel" badge.

build_score.description:
M5.9c: the Build Score (0–1000) and its stage (1–5), for GAR-01 and the cards; null until it was first computed. Ranks and
parts are on GET vehicles/{id}/build-score.

wizard.description: Where a draft resumes: "Entwurf · Schritt 2 von 4". Null for anything but the owner's draft.

qr.description: Owner only. The vehicle's active code, from its first publish on.

anyOf.description:
The owner row. Null for everybody but the owner when the owner asked not to be named on the vehicle page
(`show_owner_on_qr`, ADR-148 a), so a card does not name who the page itself hides.

latest_update.description: The newest entry of Verlauf that is not hidden, in one line: "Fahrwerk: Serie → KW V3 · −35 mm".

viewer.description:
M4.8: the reader's own state on this build: saved in one of their collections, their private reaction
("strong" | "clean" | "low" | "loud", null while build_reactions is off). Null for guests. Never anybody else's, never a count.

comment_thread.description:
R5-5 [build_comments]: the car's own comment thread, so a card can open it in place. enabled: the thread is open (flag on,
the owner allows comments); can_write: this reader may write now (false for guests). Never a count.

saved_at.description: When the member saved the build, ISO 8601.

chips.description:
Discover filter chips (DISC-02): `facet` is a filter parameter (make, model, generation, year_min, year_max, power_min,
power_max, drivetrain, gearbox, fuel, wheel_diameter, wheel_brand, suspension_type, suspension_brand, exhaust_brand,
mod_category), `value` its value as the search takes it (a slug, an enum value, a number), `label` what the chip shows.
Applied as normal, editable chips. May be empty.

label.description: "KI-Vorschlag" (EU AI Act Art. 50), in the request's language.

query.description: The query as it was searched, trimmed.

vehicles.description: `count` stops at 1000; `count_capped` true means there are more: show "1000+".

members.description: `count` stops at 1000; `count_capped` true means there are more: show "1000+".

SearchSort.description:
DISC-02 sorts (02_PRODUCT_SPEC §3.7): Relevanz · Neueste · Zuletzt aktualisiert · Meiste PS. Relevance needs a text; without one the search falls back to newest. | | |---| | `relevance`
The M1.8 relevance of the typed words, then the build changed last. | | `newest`
First published, newest first. | | `updated`
Last visible change (specs, mods, photos), newest first, as Neue Builds on HOME-01. | | `power`
Power in PS, most first; builds without a power figure last. |
SearchSort.title: SearchSort

SecondFactorRequest.description: Password and a second factor (SET-05 off, new recovery codes): a six-digit authenticator code or a recovery code ("ABCDE-FGHJK").
SecondFactorRequest.title: SecondFactorRequest

SecureAccountLinkRequest.description: POST auth/secure-account: the token of a login alert's "Das war ich nicht" link (the fragment of /auth/secure#t=…).
SecureAccountLinkRequest.title: SecureAccountLinkRequest

SecureAccountRequest.description: POST me/security/secure (SET-21 "Das war ich nicht"): optionally the row that was not the member.

security_event_id.description: The SET-21 row the member did not do; it goes into the support request.

SecureAccountRequest.title: SecureAccountRequest

ticket_reference.description: The support request that was opened ("SC-7H2KQXMB").

password_reset_required.description: The next sign-in with the password asks for a new one by e-mail code.

removed.description:
What was removed because it was added since the reported sign-in (SEC-M47-01): passkeys and provider links (counts), a pending
e-mail change, and a second factor turned on since then. The app lists them on the confirmation.

SecurityActivity.description: The rows of SET-21 Sicherheitsaktivität (09 §7.9, §8.4): what a member sees of their member_security_events. Several audit actions can share a row type (both locks are `sign_in_locked`); bookkeeping events (registration, token rotation, renames) are not shown.
SecurityActivity.title: SecurityActivity

occurred_at.description: ISO 8601. For `sign_in_failed`, the first failure of that day; `details.last_at` is the latest.

device.description: The device it happened on, when known; null for a staff action.

this_device.description: The app install of this request.

approx_city.description: "München": approximate, only with a GeoLite2 database (OA-33).

anyOf.description: How the member signed in (sign-in rows).

by_staff.description: Done by the Speedclub team (e.g. sessions ended by support).

details.description:
What else the row names: `provider` (apple, google), `passkey_provider` (iCloud-Schlüsselbund, …), `count` and `steps`
{password, email_code, second_factor} of failed attempts with `last_at`, `devices` and `sessions` signed out, `recovery_codes_left`.

can_secure.description: Offers "Das war ich nicht" (POST me/security/secure with this id).

SendMessageRequest.description:
`POST conversations/{id}/messages` (m2.4-contract §2). Text ≤ 2000 characters, trimmed, not empty; a photo by the media id of
`POST conversations/{id}/media`; a vehicle by its id. `client_id` (and the Idempotency-Key header) stay the same through every retry.

body.description: The text of a text message, at most 2000 characters.

reply_to_id.description:
SM11 reply (ADR-445): the id of a message of this conversation you can see. A message you deleted for yourself, one before
your clearing point or one that is gone is 422.

client_id.description: Your id of the message, stable across retries (a UUID).

SendMessageRequest.title: SendMessageRequest

errors.description: Messages by field; empty when the error is not about one field.

SessionKind.description: SET-06: an app sign-in is a Sanctum token, a browser sign-in is a cookie session.
SessionKind.title: SessionKind

SetForumSolutionRequest.description: "Gelöst": the reply of this thread that solved it.
SetForumSolutionRequest.title: SetForumSolutionRequest

SetHighlightsRequest.description: The whole rail in order: up to 8 build updates (own posts and notes, not hidden) or finished photos of this vehicle and its updates.
SetHighlightsRequest.title: SetHighlightsRequest

ShareCardElement.description: CF-6 (VEH-07): what a share card can show besides the photo, the make and the model (ShareCardOptions::$show).
ShareCardElement.title: ShareCardElement

email_code.description:

available.description: Password sign-in offered (`auth.password_login`, and always while the e-mail code is off, ADR-520).

other_methods.description: Ways in besides the e-mail code: password, passkeys, providers.

SignupRef.description: Where a sign-up began (ADR-216), sent by the client as `ref` on auth/register: a QR sticker scan, a public vehicle page or a public profile. Anything else is no source. Counts only; nothing about the scan or the page is stored.

SocialProvider.description: Identity providers whose ID tokens the server verifies itself (ADR-408).

cache_id.description: Send it back as `ai_suggestion.cache_id` with PUT vehicles/{id}/specs, so the taken values carry their AI provenance.

provenance_label.description: "Herstellerangabe (KI-Vorschlag)": the source of power and torque taken over, until the member changes them.

subject.description: The catalogue's name of the car, e.g. "BMW 3er E46 (1998–2006)"; never the member's text.

variants.description: Up to 6 typical factory variants; each `fields` holds only valid PUT vehicles/{id}/specs values (power_value with power_unit).

cached.description: Whether the answer came from the shared cache (no provider call).

spot_id.description: Null for the preview of a car the viewer has not spotted.

spotted.description: False for the "noch nicht gespottet" preview of DEX-04.

first_spotter.description: One of the car's first three spotters: the permanent foil.

cities_count_label.description: "In 9 Städten gespottet": cities of day spots, null when there are none or the owner hides the cities.

generated_at.description: When the numbers were counted (ISO 8601); the answer is cached for an hour.

cities.description:
Cities with counted spots of at least 5 different cars between 24 hours and 90 days old, most spots first (`count` = spots). `city_id` is the id of the static
centroid file `/geo/de-cities.json`; `bundesland` a code BW…TH. Ghost cars and cars hiding their cities never count.

spotted.description: False for the "noch nicht gespottet" preview of DEX-04.

cities_count.description: Cities of day spots; 0 while the owner hides the cities.

cities.description: Day spots only, most spotted first, at most 20; empty while the owner hides the cities.

last_30_days.description:
One entry per day (Europe/Berlin), oldest first, zeros included. Only spots older than the owner alert's 3 hours count here
(nothing live), so today's bucket and `total` can differ for a while.

recent_spotters.description:
Newest first, only spots older than the owner alert's 3 hours (nothing live). `{anonymous: true}` ("jemand") for a spotter
who keeps "Meine Spots zeigen" off.

street_famous.description: "Street Famous": 10, 50, 100 or 500 unique spotters reached, else null.
