status.description: `active` ("aktiv"), `revoked` ("gesperrt"), or `none` before the car has a code.

scans_this_week.description: Scans since Monday (German time), over all the car's codes.

anyOf.description: The current version, null before the first save.

order.description: "Bestellen": available, or why not (`no_design`, `not_validated`, `code_replaced`, `not_configured` → "Bestellung bald verfügbar").

download.description: "Herunterladen": print files exist (a validated design whose code works).

StickerColourway.title: StickerColourway

reference.description: The design id of the slug area, Shopify and the print partner: "SD" + 8 characters. Null before the first save.

revision.description:

options.description: The member's choices, every key present.

effective.description: What this template prints of the text options (a template ignores what it does not show; the choice is kept).

urls.description: Owner downloads; print files only for a validated version whose code still works.

warnings.description:

it would print smaller than 1.8 mm at this size.

StickerScanTest.description: The server's Scan-Test of a sticker design (m5.4-contract §4): the print raster decoded back to the code, or no code to test.

StickerSize.description: 10 §2.3 sizes S/M/L; the millimetres per template come from StickerCatalogue.
StickerSize.title: StickerSize

days.description: Exactly 30 entries, oldest first; `date` is YYYY-MM-DD in German time.

total.description: Since the car's first code, over all its codes.

first_scan_on.description: The first day with a scan, YYYY-MM-DD; null before the first.

sources.description: The last 30 days by source. `link` (visits through a shared link) is null until the views of M5.7 count it.

milestones_reached.description: The milestones the total has reached, of 10, 50, 100, 500, 1000.

StickerTemplate.description: The six designer templates of 10 §2.3 (STK-05), all on the unchanged logo. Geometry and sizes in App\Services\Stickers\StickerCatalogue.

StoreBuildUpdatePhotoRequest.description: Size and real file type are checked on the bytes by App\Services\Media\MediaService (413 and 415), as for every upload.

plate_blur.description:
M5.9a "Kennzeichen unkenntlich machen": `1` pixelates `blur_regions` into the photo before any file is written (every
variant, OG image and share card comes from that master; the unblurred upload is deleted). `0`: the member switched it off.
Not sent: nothing is pixelated and the owner's plate check lists the photo. Shown to the owner only, as `plate_blur.state`.

blur_regions.description:
With `plate_blur=1`: 1–8 rectangles, normalised 0–1 from the top left of the photo as displayed (after EXIF orientation);
w and h at least 0.02, x + w and y + h at most 1. Optional `angle`: degrees clockwise about the rectangle's centre,
−45 to 45 (default 0), for a plate shot at an angle; the turned rectangle is pixelated. A JSON string (multipart) or an array.
Ignored otherwise.

StoreBuildUpdatePhotoRequest.title: StoreBuildUpdatePhotoRequest

StoreBuildUpdatePostRequest.description:
UPD-01 (09 §8.5). Photos follow with POST build-updates/{id}/media. M5.9c: `kind=before_after` makes it a before/after pair: exactly
two photos follow (before, then after) and are paired by PATCH photo_pairs, or automatically when the second one arrives.

anyOf.description: M5.9c (m5.9c contract §2): a before/after shows at most one mod, as modification_id or as the one entry of modification_ids.

StoreBuildUpdatePostRequest.title: StoreBuildUpdatePostRequest

document_note.description: BIZ-02 "Nachweise": what you can show us on request (Gewerbeanmeldung, Handelsregisterauszug); never public.

sends with the statement on the details step. `message_context: true` only for a message: the server then keeps the reported message
with up to 5 before and after it.

details.description: Art. 16(2)(a) DSA: required for illegal, then at least 10 characters: a notice of illegal content explains why.

city.description: Fallback: a city name, matched to de_cities; no match stores no city.

With `plate_blur=1`: 1–8 rectangles, normalised 0–1 from the top left of the photo as displayed (after EXIF orientation);
w and h at least 0.02, x + w and y + h at most 1. Optional `angle`: degrees clockwise about the rectangle's centre,
−45 to 45 (default 0), for a plate shot at an angle; the turned rectangle is pixelated. A JSON string (multipart) or an array.
Ignored otherwise.
